title: AI Assistant
description: Agents run against the dashboard on your behalf, using the skills you attach and only the access you grant.
noAgentsDescription: An agent is a set of instructions plus the sections it may read or change.
instructionsHint: What this agent is for and how it should answer. This text is trusted; anything a tool returns is not.
limitsHint: A run stops at whichever limit it reaches first.
reportOnCompletionLabel: Send a report when a run finishes
reportOnCompletionHint: Delivered to the outgoing webhooks subscribed to agent runs.
saveAgentError: Could not save the agent. Try again.
deleteAgentDescription: The agent stops running. Its run history is kept.
deleteAgentError: Could not delete the agent. Try again.
accessDescription: The agent can only use the tools these scopes select. A skill can narrow this list, never widen it.
skillsDescription: Skill instructions are added to the agent's prompt in this order.
skillsPageDescription: A skill is reusable instructions, optionally narrowed to a few tools. It grants no access on its own.
noSkillsDescription: Write a skill once and attach it to as many agents as you like.
skillDescriptionHint: One line. Always shown to the model, even when the body is trimmed.
skillInstructionsHint: Markdown. Added to the agent's prompt when this skill is attached.
skillToolsHint: One tool name per line. Leave empty to use everything the agent's access allows.
deleteSkillDescription: The skill is removed from every agent using it. The agents keep their access.
deleteSkillError: Could not delete the skill. Try again.
saveSkillError: Could not save the skill. Try again.
runsDescription: Every run keeps the instructions it executed, so the history stays readable after the agent changes.
runError: Could not start the run. Try again.
runTaskHint: Optional. Leave empty to use the agent's own instructions.
noRunsDescription: Start one from an agent to see its steps here.
runPendingHint: Waiting for the scheduler to pick this run up.
schedulesDescription: A schedule queues a run at its time. A missed occurrence is not caught up — the next run is the next one due.
scheduleTimeZoneHint: The dashboard shows times in UTC, so the zone is stated explicitly here.
deleteScheduleDescription: The agent stops running on this schedule. Past runs are kept.
saveScheduleError: Could not save the schedule. Try again.
deleteScheduleError: Could not delete the schedule. Try again.
